notes: Read only scan 026; no other scan image was inspected. No OCR, text-recognition software, external source or TeX compilation was used.

The whole was inspected for layout, then both supplied halves line by line against both witnesses, including agreed text. Subsequent crops targeted unresolved loci, C doubts, word differences and page-state decisions.

Line count 29 counts the four top prose lines, eight marginal lines, one q line, heading, three item-a prose lines, its one display line, four cancelled lines, five proof lines and two bottom formula lines; it excludes the page number and the diagram’s three object rows.
The a) prose reads G′ de F, despite the separate relation F≤G′≼G. The narrow F shape is clear; no mathematical repair to G is made.
The lower index reads x∈|F|\|G|. H’s reversed order is not adopted. The first-line support is also |F|; its cramped remainder is left doubtful.
The unfinished line Ainsi, … F has been kept separate from cancelled b), because the third long line ends comme and the next begins a new capitalized fragment. No tel is visible after comme.
No inserted passage or insertion caret was found on this page. The slanted note is an independent marginal note, not an insertion into the running text.

The left vertical grouping mark beside a) is reproduced in the proposed draft, but the final reader may choose the edition’s preferred treatment of a nonlexical marginal mark. Its presence is certain; its editorial function is not asserted.
Bottom first-line end is clipped and turns down the sheet edge. The probable outer closing brace is a marked candidate, not silently supplied from set syntax.
No authorial question mark or explicit verbal doubt was found. Apparent authorial slips are the prose de F and the literal reversed support difference; both are retained.
The exact manuscript dots in tightly compressed abbreviations are not always separately drawn; no expansion into full words is licensed by that compression.
The q formula’s small entry loop is not confidently separable into composition circle plus p; draft marks the circle rather than choosing a mathematical convention.

check_events.premises: If |F| is the union/support of the members of F, as suggested by the proof’s comparison |F|=|G|.
check_events.check: For the literal lower expression F coproduct_{x∈|F|\|G|} {{x}}, every adjoined singleton has its point already in |F|. Therefore the resulting support remains |F|.
check_events.result: This cannot in general enlarge the support from |F| to |G|. It flagged the order of F,G for reinspection, but the clear literal F-before-G reading was retained.
